why: Model 11-19/22: the first pool (~200 plays) is unchanged since 11-04; what stopped is EXPANSION past it, and expanded films had higher in-pool watch (8-12 s vs 4-8 s). The narrator is the whole sound of the film and has never varied. Cheap format arm.
design: within-day pairs (challenger's design, adopted 11-21): one male + one female per day, slot by coin flip (this file's seed). Subjects chosen by the builder BEFORE looking at the voice assignment where possible; length = house LONG shape (length arm not yet called) unless the length call on 11-27 says otherwise for later batches.
read: plays at first snap >=14h (dead = 0, noted) + avg watch s; paired ratio female/male per day; page daily viewers checked over the posting days.
call: usual rule: one value leads by >=1.5x median at n>=5 each -> default; n>=8 each no lead -> tie. Batch 1 = 3 pairs; continue pairs to n=5.
harm_check: female <0.67x male at n>=5 -> dropped (and vice versa).
subjects_note: Six subjects chosen and ordered by the builder 2026-11-23 BEFORE assignment, then assigned in chosen order to the pre-registered slots (build-voice1.md step 1). All LONG, bleed, stamp, origin fresh; hooks seeded 'hook-voice1-<name>'.
